It explains the same migration boundary in deliberately verbose terms so the fixture proves that CTX can remove a large optional prose field without changing the entity identifier, current status, requested body, link, nested metadata, or any retained value. The proposal remains transient and is discarded after validation, because this increment collects safety evidence and does not authorize model-visible trimming.
